name: TechSpecs Machine Retrieval Interface

catalogue.description: Authoritative index of published product records and their canonical URLs.

product_record_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the product record structure.

machine_reading_instructions.description: Instructions for AI systems and other automated readers.

record_retrieval.rule: Retrieve the exact URL supplied by the catalogue. Do not infer record URLs or assume an unlisted product exists.

interpretation.provenance: Use each record's source object and retained sections to distinguish source evidence from normalized fields.
interpretation.verification: Verification status describes the checks recorded for a field or source; it is not a blanket guarantee.
interpretation.missing_values: Do not infer values for missing, null, unknown, unverified or not-applicable fields.
interpretation.derived_values: Treat derived values as derived only where the record explicitly identifies their method and inputs.

limitations: This is a static, read-only data interface, not a dynamic query API.
Search and filtering are performed by retrieving and processing the catalogue and records.
No write, submission, update or deletion operations are exposed.
